title: OKR transmission, handoff, and cross-functional initiative slate
creator: Avery Chen
description: Define and operationalize an 'OKR transmission' pattern so company-level objectives transition cleanly into a balanced, cross-functional initiative slate. This ticket scopes the handoff ritual, the initiative freeze window, owner mapping, and the contingency capacity pool for Q2 planning. Outcome: a repeatable playbook + templated Confluence doc + rollout to PM/Eng/Design leads. Workstreams include: (1) objective decomposition rules, (2) initiative sizing guardrails and capacity hedging, (3) cross-team owner roster and acceptance criteria, (4) tooling changes to the roadmap board and intake form.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence playbook published: OKR transmission ritual, responsibilities, timeline
Initiative slate template added to roadmap board with required fields (owner, success metric, effort band)
Hedge pool mechanism defined and approved (4% of engineering capacity reserve)
3 pilot teams complete handoff using the new template and submit feedback
Runbook for escalation when initiative conflicts occur (priority arbitration protocol)
milestones: 2025-02-28: Eng & Infra review and capacity hedge proposal
updates: 2025-02-11 — Avery Chen: Kickoff with PM leads. Aligned on transmission concept: explicit objective -> initiative mapping with mandatory owner and success metric.
2025-02-18 — Riley Patel: Draft intake template posted to Confluence (link below). Design feedback: add a 'risk/resolution' field and visibility tags.
2025-02-24 — Morgan Drake (Eng): Reviewed capacity hedge. Proposal: keep 4% of Dedicated capacity as contingency; Ops to reserve until week-of cutover.
2025-02-28 — Riley Patel: Pilot squads identified (Search, Console, Billing). Pilot kickoff scheduled for 2025-03-03. Minor change: add 'rollback trigger' to acceptance criteria.
recent_decision: Adopt 4% capacity hedge tied to Dedicated pool; require explicit owner + one success metric for every initiative moving from company OKR to roadmap slate.
next_steps: Finalize intake template incorporating Design and Security feedback
Schedule pilot syncs with the three squads (Search, Console, Billing)
Update roadmap board to surface initiative status and hedge allocation
Prepare announcement and training doc for PM leads (short video + Q&A)
risks: Capacity hedge reduces headroom for stretch work; needs executive sign-off if >4%
Incomplete owner mapping could cause duplicate efforts across squads
Tooling changes to the roadmap board may require a migration window and small infra effort
